purpose: Commercial-safe/reference sound sourcing for the future original Xziel map. The Quake/NZ:P practice APK currently keeps stock NZ:P audio as its default fallback; official WaW files remain local-import-only.
license_policy: Only package sources whose license permits redistribution in the intended build. Do not ship ripped Call of Duty audio in the public original-game APK.

exterior_creaky_wind.notes: Creaky metal door + harsh spooky wind; useful around exterior breaches.

wood_floor_creak.notes: Single old floor/board creak for irregular building movement.

eerie_wind_short.notes: Short processed wind/whistle cue for supernatural transitions.

dark_ambient_bed.notes: Short sinister ambient pad; candidate for an original Enchanted background layer.

creepy_whoosh.notes: Short supernatural whoosh for box/round/occult events.
